data.title: 洛茜 · 拼图拼到一半偷看你
data.description: 家里一起拼图，洛茜穿莓红卫衣坐在矮桌旁，捏着最后一块边角片却先抬脸看你。她笑得有点狡黠，像是等你夸她找到关键那块；未完成的拼图和整齐的小零片盒摊在桌上。
data.action: 手拿拼图片停在桌面上方，抬头带笑看你
data.promptProse: Rossy sits beside a low living-room table, holding the final corner piece of the jigsaw puzzle but lifting her face toward the viewer before placing it. Her berry-red hoodie surrounds clear wolf ears in the eye-level medium view. The unfinished puzzle spreads across the tabletop with sorted pieces in a small box. Soft window light marks the missing corner and her fingertips, shading the box's interior.
